previous.changeLog: Added gun caliber, ammunition capacity, and penetration at 500 meters to the vehicle statistics. Improved Firepower ordering and shell-selection presentation. Added Shell Calibration support to Armor Inspector. Added a vanilla-style attacker shell-mode switch for vehicles such as the Pz.Kpfw. Neu. Added native-style Tier XI upgrades to the Loadout Sandbox. Selecting an advanced Tier XI upgrade now automatically activates its prerequisites; selecting the final upgrade activates the complete tree. Tier XI upgrade trees now scale to fit without scrolling. Restored native field-modification level and upgrade icons. Made sandbox selections respond immediately while statistics recalculate in the background. Significantly improved Loadout Sandbox scrolling speed. Improved compatibility with World of Tanks 2.4.

previous.changeLog:
v7.3.0 - six new languages + WoT 2.4.0.0.

NEW: French, Spanish, German, Czech, Italian and Portuguese. SpotMeter now speaks eight languages (EN / PL / FR / ES / DE / CS / IT / PT) across the in-battle panel and every label and hover tooltip in the settings menu, using the game's own terminology. Pick one in the settings menu, or set "language" in spotmeter.json; "auto" follows your WoT client and now matches on the language-code prefix, so regional variants get their own language instead of English.

Fixed: the settings menu now keeps the language you picked after you close the window, and the battle panel's footer is translated instead of always showing Polish.

Rebuilt for WoT 2.4.0.0 the spot-distance engine, circle and panel are unchanged.
